text:
Friday: Ronaldo scores goal #980 for Al Nassr. Saturday: Portugal's FA provisionally suspends him after he left the national team camp. He has said the punishment should have "no mitigating circumstances". Fair or too harsh? 👇
#Ronaldo #CristianoRonaldo #Portugal #AlNassr #Football
titulo: Cristiano Ronaldo provisionally suspended by Portugal after scoring goal 980
notas: Al Jazeera 10/10 (suspension provisional, 1-6 meses segun reports, cita 'no mitigating circumstances') + titulares 13 medios; 980 Sky/beIN; jurado 3 subagentes 8/7/8=7,7 [cola]; dato nuevo vs 10/10 = suspension
